_comment: K3, X100 cores only (TASK-008 P1, 2026-10-28): the K1 ffn_ime workload (mlp_control at 100 Hz beside ffn_block at 10 Hz) on the K3's 8 X100 cores. Same networks, periods and dispatch graphs as networks_k1_ffn_ime.json; profiles come from the K3 tree (k3-work/gen/k3), measured on X100 cpu 0. enable_impls: each dispatch has an rvv_x60 and an ime_x60 cost cell.
